p.i: tur se judicio conveniri.d.§.sed furti.26. [Item negans deposi-tum miserabilis l.1.§.1.& seqq.ff.depos.§.20.inf. de act. Item condictio ex chyrographo, inficiatione crescit in duplum. Nov. 18.Verum moribus omnia indebita soluta repetantur:nec ullum debitum sive ulla lis inficiando crescit in duplum. v. Groenw. hic & ad l.14.nu.34.C.de SS.eccl.]

main_text.head: AXIOMATA

p.i: 2. Æquum est, absentium, qui subita festinatione coacti, peregre profecti sunt, negotia non deseri.d.§.1.
3. Nemo absentis negotia facile curaret, nisi impensas repeteret posset.d.§.1.
4. Negotiorum gestor, si ejus contemplatione alius ab administratione abstinuit, exactissimam.d.§.4. aliat exactam diligentiam regulariter præstat.C.d.neg.gest.l.tutori 20.
5. Qui tutelam subit, nullum negotium cum pupillo contrahit.§.
6. Rei communio sine societate, est quasi contractus.§.3.
7. Qui hæreditatem adit, quasi contrahit cum legatariis.§.5. cum creditoribus hæreditariis.ff.quibus ex causis in poss.ea. l.3.§.ult.
8. Solutio indebiti est quasi contractus, id est, distractus.§.pe[?] conjun.§.1.supra quib.mod.re cont.obl.
9. Indebitum accipiens obligatur quasi ex mutuo.d.§.penult.con-jun.d.§.1.
10. Ex quibus causis per inficiationem lis crescit, ex his causis debitum solutum non repetitur.§ ult.
11. Ex lege Aquilia inficiantes damnantur in duplum, confitentes in simplum.d.§.ult.conjun.§.sed furti.26.infra de act.
12. Qui legatum loco pio relictum falso inficiatur, condemnatur in duplum.d.§.ult.idem est si solvere differat, donec judicio contraveniatur.d.§.sed furti.26.

main_text.head: PER QVAS PERSONA[?] NOBIS OBLIGATIO ADQVIRITVR.
TITVLVS. XXIIX.
main_text.p: POstquam expofuit modos, quibus obligatio dicitur acquiritur ex contractu, vel quasi contractu: consequenter agit de per quos acquiritur, qua methodo usus est etiā in tractatu do-[?]minio. lib. 2. tit. 9. cum quo hic tit. est conferendus, & ex illo[illegible, ~3 letters]

page.notes: Right edge of the scan is covered by the neighbouring page, so the ends of lines 2 to 4 of the opening paragraph are partly lost; the readings there are inferred and marked [?]. The large initial P is joined to "Postquam". The title line "PER QVAS PERSONA[?]" is cut at the right edge. Several axiom references (§ numbers, "pe[?]" in axiom 8) are doubtful. Leading "tur" at the top is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The bracketed passage at the top appears in the printed text, not as a marginal note.
